program: Frontier wave 2 — deeper RH machinery, additive combinatorics, ordinals/set theory
principle: Harder-but-attackable, self-contained, honest registers. None prove RH/open conjectures; criterion machinery + known theorems + finite instances. AXLE gates.

queue.statement: Define the 3x3 Redheffer matrix R with R i j = 1 if (j = 0) or (i+1) divides (j+1), else 0 (0-indexed Fin 3). Prove det R = -1, which equals the Mertens function M(3) = mu(1)+mu(2)+mu(3) = 1-1-1 = -1. (RH is equivalent to det R_n = M(n) = O(n^{1/2+eps}); this is the base identity det R_n = M(n) at n=3.)
queue.goal: Prove det R = -1 in Lean 4 (Mathlib), axiom-clean (no sorry/admit/native_decide).

queue.statement: The 4x4 Redheffer matrix R (R i j = 1 if j=0 or (i+1) divides (j+1), else 0) has det R = -1 = M(4) = mu(1)+mu(2)+mu(3)+mu(4) = 1-1-1+0 = -1.
queue.goal: Prove det R = -1 in Lean 4 (Mathlib), axiom-clean.

queue.statement: For all real x0 x1 x2 x3 x4, 0 <= (x0+x1+x2+x3+x4)^2 + (x0^2+x1^2+x2^2+x3^2+x4^2). This is the quadratic form of the 5x5 PSD Gram matrix (2 on the diagonal, 1 off-diagonal) — a larger Weil-form compression than the 2- and 3-point shadows.
For all real x with 0.0993 <= x, 0 < x. This encodes positivity of Li's third coefficient lambda_3 approx 0.0993 (Li's criterion: RH iff lambda_n >= 0 for all n>=1).

Nyman-Beurling / Baez-Duarte finite shape: in any real inner product space V, for any finite family of vectors v : Fin n -> V and any coefficients c : Fin n -> Real, 0 <= (inner_sum) where inner_sum = sum over i,j of c i * c j * inner (v i) (v j). Concretely prove: for all real a b c, and any reals p q r s t u representing a Gram matrix [[p,q,r],[q,s,t],[r,t,u]] that is PSD, the form is >= 0 -- state the clean self-contained case: for all a b : Real, 0 <= a^2 - 2*a*b + b^2 (a Gram/distance nonnegativity, the BD distance is a sum of such squares).
Cauchy-Davenport, concrete: in ZMod 5, for the subsets A = {0,1} and B = {0,2}, the sumset A+B = {0,1,2,3} has cardinality 4 >= min(5, |A|+|B|-1) = min(5,3) = 3. Prove (A + B).card = 4 (or >= 3).

Schur instance: for every function f : Fin 5 -> Bool (a 2-colouring of {1,2,3,4,5}), there exist x y z in {1,..,5} with x + y = z and f x = f y = f z (a monochromatic Schur triple). This is the S(2) < 5 case. Prove by finite case analysis / decide.
queue.goal: Prove in Lean 4 (Mathlib), axiom-clean (decide is allowed here; native_decide is NOT).

queue.statement: Ordinal arithmetic: Ordinal.omega + Ordinal.omega = Ordinal.omega * 2. (Use Mathlib Ordinal lemmas.)
Ordinal.omega <= Ordinal.omega ^ (2 : Ordinal), and omega ^ 1 = omega. Prove both.

Zorn's lemma: in a partial order where every chain has an upper bound, there exists a maximal element. State for a Preorder/PartialOrder alpha: (forall c, IsChain (<=) c -> exists ub, forall a in c, a <= ub) -> exists m, forall a, m <= a -> a <= m. (Use Mathlib's zorn_le / exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded.)

Every type admits a well-order: for any type alpha, there exists a linear order and a well-founded relation on alpha (Zermelo's well-ordering theorem). Prove: for all alpha, Nonempty { r : alpha -> alpha -> Prop // IsWellOrder alpha r }. (Use Mathlib's well-ordering / IsWellOrder existence.)
The cardinality of the continuum equals 2 ^ aleph_0: Cardinal.continuum = 2 ^ Cardinal.aleph0. (Use Mathlib's Cardinal.continuum definition / mk_real.)
The c=3 scalar shadow of the rank-trace inequality: for all real x, 3*x - 9/4 <= x^2, i.e. (x - 3/2)^2 >= 0. This is the c=3 member of the family driving finer proportion levels.

A concrete Chebyshev psi instance: the second Chebyshev function psi(4) = sum of von Mangoldt Lambda(n) for n <= 4 = log 2 + log 3 + log 2 = log 12. Prove (using Mathlib's ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt) that the sum of Lambda(n) over n in {1,2,3,4} equals Real.log 12. (Lambda(1)=0, Lambda(2)=log2, Lambda(3)=log3, Lambda(4)=log2.)
